TCS Q2 FY27 Revenue, Profit Up
: TCS Q2 FY27: revenue per FTE rose 1.5% to $12,778; headcount up 0.8%. Sept quarter consolidated net profit Rs13,884 crore; revenue Rs73,188 crore, up 11.2% YoY.
: Nomura kept Buy on TCS, target Rs 2,630 after US meetings. TCS reports $3.1B annualized AI revenue (~10% of sales), 15–20% quarterly AI revenue growth, early frontier AI uptake in BFSI and tech.
: TCS may gain from enterprise AI demand, aiding clients with AI deployment and system integration. Traders should note risks: pricing pressure and rising infrastructure costs could curb IT spending.
